items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember going to see Al Hibbler

ctx.x: So you didn’t get to go out too much as an audience member, but every once in a while. I think you once told me that you saw Nat Cole at a theater.
RKO Palace. But I didn’t meet him. I just saw him. He’s one of the few people I got to see. I remember going to see Al Hibbler, but he – because he was working at the
502. If I were not working and it was somebody that came in at the 502, I would go see them with a girlfriend.
